general_information.Description: Building on the successful top-down approach, the course of Computer Networking is implemented with an early emphasis on application-layer paradigms and application programming interfaces, encouraging a hands-on experience with protocols and networking concepts.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FU CMS at http://cms.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information
general_information.Tools: Internet Linux operating system server and/ or desktop

description: Building on the successful top-down approach, the course of Computer Networking is implemented with an early emphasis on application-layer paradigms and application programming interfaces, encouraging a hands-on experience with protocols and networking concepts.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Details of architecture of OSI and TCP/IP model,
Using basic shell command in Linux system fluently
Fundamental of shell, C language on Linux
Main problems of Network through some simulative exercises
Information searching, reading and selection skills
Working in group, documention and presentation skills

assessments.Question Type: Multiple choicesMarked by Computer or a suitable format
assessments.No Question: 10-30 (At least 10*n questions where n is the number of Chapters covered in the test.)
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Current chapter(s) Each Progess Test covers at least 01 Chapter and at most 03 Chapters, and overall they must cover all learned Chapters of the course.
assessments.Note: Instruction and shedules for Progress tests must be presented in the Course Implementation Plan approved by director of the campus. Progress test must be taken right after the last lectures of required material. Instructor has resposibility to review the test for students after graded.

assessments.Grading Guide: prepare at home, working in group, present in class hours

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: concepts, algorithms; all studied chapters, more than 70% new questions (for the current semester);
